# 32 Model 2B chain 2

## 1. Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(tictoc)
library(mvtnorm)
library(parallel)

# General functions
source(here('R', 'adaptive_manager_matrix_M2.R'))
source(here('R', 'log_utils.R'))
source(here('R', 'traceplot.R'))
# For this model
source(here('R', 'model_matrix_M2.R'))
source(here('R', 'mcmc_core_M2.R'))

# Path Setting
rds_path = here('analysis', '02_M2_Model2', 'results')
plot_path = here('analysis', '02_M2_Model2', 'plots')
cm = 1 / 2.54
```

```{r}
# Necessary Data
target_stats = readRDS(here('analysis', '02_M2_Model2', 'results', 'M2_target_stats_8.rds'))
nodes = readRDS(here('analysis', '02_M2_Model2', 'results', 'simulation_nodes.rds'))

n_school = c(1, 1, 3, 4)

# Static Data for Network Generation
static_data = get_static_data_m2_5(nodes, n_school = n_school)

# Model Functions
model_funcs = list(
  generate = calc_prob_m2_3,
  calc_stats = calc_expected_stats_matrix_m2_6,
  loglik = calc_loglik_m2
)
```

```{r}
# Stage 5 of Adaptive Matrix 18 (Pre-final stage)
prev_chain_data = readRDS(here(rds_path, 'M2_Adaptive_Matrix_18_20260327_185930.rds'))
prev_chain = as.data.frame(prev_chain_data$chain)
burn_in_ind = floor(prev_chain_data$config$n_iter * prev_chain_data$config$burn_in)
clean_chain = prev_chain[-(1 : burn_in_ind), ]
```

## 2. Hyper Parameters

```{r}
# --- MCMC Basic Settings ---
n_iter        = 20000
burn_in_ratio = 0.2
safety_margin = 1.0
n_school = c(1, 1, 3, 4)
```

```{r}
# --- Initial Covariance Matrix ---
n_params = ncol(clean_chain)
optimal_scale = (2.38 ^ 2) / n_params
shrinkage_factor = 1 / 2
init_proposal_cov = cov(clean_chain) * optimal_scale * shrinkage_factor * safety_margin

# --- Initial Params (Chain 2: -2SD) ---
chain_sd = apply(clean_chain, 2, sd)
init_params = colMeans(clean_chain) - 2 * chain_sd

# Make sure init params won't exceed the constraint
init_params["sigma_re"]  = max(init_params["sigma_re"], 0.01)
init_params["sigma_hhd"] = max(init_params["sigma_hhd"], 0.01)
init_params["lambda"]    = max(init_params["lambda"], 0.001)
if("w" %in% names(init_params)) {
  init_params["w"]       = max(min(init_params["w"], 0.99), 0.01)
}

print(init_proposal_cov)
print(init_params)
```

```{r}
# Static Data for Network Generation
static_data = get_static_data_m2_5(nodes, n_school = n_school)
```

## 3. Config

```{r}
config = list(
  name = 'Model2B_chain2',
  theme = 'M2',
  note = paste0('Chain 2 of model 2B (-2SD)'),
  n_iter = n_iter,
  burn_in = burn_in_ratio,
  n_school = n_school,
  safety_margin = safety_margin,
  init_params = init_params,
  init_cov = init_proposal_cov,
  target_mu = target_stats$mu,
  target_sigma = target_stats$sigma,
  output_dir = here('analysis', '02_M2_Model2')
)
```

## 4. Run Adaptive MCMC

```{r}
# ----------------------------------------------------
# 【Check before Simulation】Initial Network
# ----------------------------------------------------
test_net = model_funcs$generate(init_params, static_data)
test_stats = model_funcs$calc_stats(test_net, static_data)

cat("=== Initial Stats vs Target ===\n")
print(rbind(
  "Simulation" = test_stats,
  "Target"     = target_stats$mu
))
# ----------------------------------------------------
```

```{r}
# Implementation

# 3. Run MCMC
tic()
mcmc_result = run_mcmc(
  n_iter = config$n_iter, 
  current_params = config$init_params, 
  proposal_cov = config$init_cov,
  static_data = static_data,
  target_mu = config$target_mu,
  target_sigma = config$target_sigma,
  generate_func = model_funcs$generate,
  calc_stats_func = model_funcs$calc_stats,
  loglik_func = model_funcs$loglik
)
log_time = toc()

save_mcmc_result(
  result = mcmc_result,
  config = config,
  time_log = log_time,
  output_dir = config$output_dir
)

cat("MCMC have successfully finished!")
```
